info.name: Neomora Club Manager API
info.description:
# Neomora Club Manager API

Complete Postman collection covering every endpoint exposed by the backend.

## Setup

1. Make sure the API is running locally (`npm run start:dev`) on `http://localhost:3000`.
2. Open the collection variables (or create an environment) and set:
   - `baseUrl` — defaults to `http://localhost:3000/api/v1`
   - `tenantSlug` — the slug for your tenant (e.g. `main-club`)
   - `staffEmail`, `staffPassword` — a SUPER_ADMIN account to log in with
3. Run **Auth → Login**. The test script stores `accessToken` and `refreshToken` automatically.
4. All staff-protected requests then use `Bearer {{accessToken}}` via the request-level auth.

## API key (partner) flow

1. Run **API Keys → Create API Key** — its test script stores the plaintext into `{{apiKey}}`.
2. On the partner-friendly endpoints (List Participants / Sessions / Payments / Locations etc.), enable the `x-api-key` header. The bearer auth is overridden by the API-key header server-side.

## Notes

- Replace `:id`, `:slug`, `:participantId`, `:docId`, `:noteId`, `:gateway` path placeholders before sending.
- For Arabic validation messages set `Accept-Language: ar`.
- File-upload requests use `multipart/form-data` — Postman handles this automatically when you select the file.
- Full reference docs are in `API_DOCUMENTATION.md` and live Swagger at `http://localhost:3000/api/docs`.

item.name: 1. Auth (Staff)
item.description:
Staff login, refresh, profile, logout, switch tenant, 2FA, password reset.

The Login request automatically stores `accessToken` and `refreshToken` into the active environment.

header.description: Use "ar" to receive Arabic validation messages.

request.description:
POST /auth/login

Returns `{ accessToken, refreshToken, user, tenant }`.

When the user has `totpEnabled=true`, add `totpCode` (6 digits) to the body.

5 wrong-password attempts in a row lock the account for 15 minutes.

request.description: Same endpoint as Login — use when 2FA is enabled on the account. `totpCode` MUST be exactly 6 digits.
